description: Every text change LexAPI observed on a document, newest first. These are snapshots of the document as LexAPI fetched it — NOT the law in force on a date (for that use lex_semantic_legislation with asOf, or a consolidated CELEX). History starts when the document entered the corpus. Cost: 1 credit.

language.description: Language: ISO 639-1 code of an official EU language (en, fr, de, …; default en).

name: lex_document_versions
title: Version history of a document
